sequence.prompt: What happened at Lazarus' grave? Put it in order.

items.label: Mary fell down at Jesus' feet
Sad things will not last for ever

matches.prompt: Match each one to what the story says.
matches.questionTemplate: What does the story say about {left}?

pairs.right: It is right — Jesus did it too
A horrible thing never meant to be here
Real tears and real hope together

application.question: Jesus cried with His friends. Who could you tell when you feel sad?
application.followUp: Jesus knew Lazarus would walk out of that tomb in a few minutes, and He still stood there and cried. So you are not doing it wrong when you are sad. Jesus cried too — and one day God will wipe every tear away.
